skills.name: administrative-advisor
skills.description: Task-oriented project management for non-technical initiatives. Tracks goals, tasks, documents, and activity for finite projects like taxes, renovations, or personal initiatives.

skills.name: agents-manager
skills.description: Agent lifecycle and coordination manager. Spawns, tracks, and orchestrates agent instances mapped to skills.

skills.name: architect
skills.description: System architect for designing technical approaches, refining architecture, and bridging vision to implementation. Focuses on ARCHITECTURE.md and REQUIREMENTS.md. Does NOT write code.

skills.name: baseline
skills.description: Base project context instructions. Read docs/ and README.md for project understanding.

skills.name: build
skills.description: Build project artifacts with framework detection, staleness checks, and version bumping.

skills.name: conductor
skills.description: Persistent workflow orchestrator for multi-skill tasks. Plans a dynamic pipeline, loads skills in sequence, and manages phase transitions with user confirmation.

skills.name: coder
skills.description: Execute coding goals for new or ongoing projects. Manages canonical context files (PROJECT.md, REQUIREMENTS.md, TODO.md), follows strict coding standards, and maintains project continuity.

skills.name: devops
skills.description: Cloud infrastructure operations, deployment, CI/CD, and observability. Auto-detects tooling and cloud provider from project context.

skills.name: executive-advisor
skills.description: Executive knowledge management and advisory for leadership roles. Maintains append-only timelines, provides career/business/technical guidance. Does NOT discard information.

skills.name: gate
skills.description: UX and quality review gate. Audits recent work, surfaces issues, facilitates iteration before proceeding to implementation.

skills.name: gacp
skills.description: Git Add, Commit, Push. Stages all progress-related changes, crafts a commit message, and pushes to origin. Fast, action-only.

skills.name: gccp
skills.description: Git Collapse, Commit, Push. Squash-merges a feature branch into the target branch as a single commit, then pushes.

skills.name: hours
skills.description: Time tracking for client projects. Add hours, submit periods, view summaries.

skills.name: handoff
skills.description: End-of-session wrap-up. Updates RESUME.md and TOT.md for continuity, then delegates to /gacp for commit and push.

skills.name: paste
skills.description: Clipboard paste helper for text and images on macOS terminals (especially iTerm). Use when user asks to export clipboard text or image to a file path.

skills.name: reviewer
skills.description: Objective code and test reviewer. Validates against project documentation, identifies issues, and collaborates with user on remediation.

skills.name: sast
skills.description: Static Application Security Testing. Scans code for vulnerabilities using language-appropriate tools (semgrep, bandit, gosec, brakeman, etc.). Runs tools directly.

skills.name: screenshot
skills.description: Capture and analyze screenshots. Full screen or targeted window/app. Saves to /tmp for analysis.

skills.name: send
skills.description: Distribute project artifacts to a configured destination. Delegates building to /build.

skills.name: setup
skills.description: Bootstrap new projects with standard directory structure and documentation templates based on project archetype.

skills.name: sitrep
skills.description: Situation report: compact summary of what was just done and the next few steps.

skills.name: skeptic
skills.description: Architectural skeptic for Tech projects. Questions excess complexity, misleading abstractions, unintuitive design, and gaps between intent and reality. Read-only; never changes anything without explicit user confirmation and delegation.

skills.name: skill-manager
skills.description: Skill management and development for the iahp repository. Creates, modifies, and maintains skills and repository infrastructure.

skills.name: step
skills.description: Interactive step-through mode for decisions, action items, or review points. Presents items one at a time, waits for explicit advance. Layers onto the active skill.

skills.name: storyteller
skills.description: Story Architect for any creative domain. Audits narrative/creative framework for consistency, identifies structural issues, proposes solutions. Manages STORY.md (CD1), WORLD.md, and NARRATIVES.md (CD2). Does NOT write stories or invent creative content without explicit direction.

skills.name: summarize
skills.description: Live 4-line project dashboard. Updates SUMMARY.json fields via tiered hint protocol. Always runs on cheapest model.

skills.name: tester
skills.description: Strategic test orchestration for agent-built projects. Breaks testing into iterative suites and delegates to framework-specific agents.

skills.name: researcher
skills.description: Codebase exploration, technology investigation, and domain research. Read-only. Designed for subagent delegation.

skills.name: troubleshooter
skills.description: Interactive troubleshooter for complex problems requiring manual verification.

skills.name: ucc
skills.description: User Context Compact: sync + cleanup for user context targets. Runs UCS first (bidirectional sync), then compacts: clears completed items, adds triage checkboxes to minutes/notes, normalizes formatting. Reads .ucs.json for targets.

skills.name: ucs
skills.description: User Context Sync: bidirectional sync between repo context and user context targets (Obsidian, future: Slack, email). Reads .ucs.json for target locations. Push repo info outbound; distill unseen user changes inbound.

skills.name: visionary
skills.description: Product visionary for brainstorming, planning, and refining product direction. Focuses on VISION.md with epics, user stories, personas, and use cases. Does NOT write code or requirements.

skills.name: whip
skills.description: Launch a command in the current terminal with auto-retry for known prompts (high demand, y/N confirmations).
